unit: dissertations (strict History PhDs completed 2009-2026, in_analysis: true); never citation counts

inputs.identity: canadian-historiography-scholars-request-2026-10-12/candidates.csv and identity-decisions.csv (namesake works removed); non-candidates by graph person keys listed per person
inputs.script: computed with a scratch script mirroring groups_evidence.py (person_works with identity decisions); not committed

caveats: Bibliographies list works consulted, not influence or endorsement.
Engagement = cites works by at least two roster people; rosters differ from groups.json anchors, so shares differ from ../evidence.json.
Francophone universities = montreal, uqam, sherbrooke, laval (179 of 1303 PhDs; Laval is thin, 9). Ottawa is bilingual and not counted.
Graph person keys for non-candidates are not identity-reviewed; variant keys may be missed, so small counts are lower bounds.
Years are mostly repository issued dates.
